rules.title: Residential Security Deposit Maximum
rules.requirement: A landlord may not demand or receive residential security in an amount exceeding one month's rent in addition to first month's rent, except that certain natural persons or limited liability companies owning no more than two residential rental properties with a total of no more than four units may charge up to two months' rent.
rules.key_value: 1 month rent (general); 2 months rent (small landlord exception)

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property used as a dwelling, with exceptions for certain small landlords owning 2 or fewer properties with a total of no more than 4 units.
coverage.owner_condition: Natural person or LLC of natural persons owning no more than 2 residential rental properties totaling no more than 4 dwelling units.

rules.exemptions: Does not apply to advance payments of six months or more for leases of six months or longer, mutual agreements for structural or decorative alterations, or certain small landlords meeting specific natural person and unit count criteria.
rules.quoted_span: Except as provided in paragraph (2), (3), or (5), a landlord shall not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of an amount equal to one month’s rent, in addition to any rent for the first month paid on or before initial occupancy.

rules.title: Security Deposit Return Deadline and Itemized Accounting
rules.requirement: Landlords must furnish an itemized statement and return the remaining security deposit within 21 calendar days after the tenant vacates the premises.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential tenancies for security deposit return and accounting.
